item.title: Speed Merchant FXR Chopper: Brandon Holstein’s Motul Hot Bike Tour Build
item.description: Brandon Holstein of The Speed Merchant rode a rare Frisco-style FXR chopper on the 2025 Motul Hot Bike Tour, proving that the best custom motorcycles are built to ride.

item.title: Harley-Davidson Adds New Chrome and Solo Trim Options to 2026 Road Glide, Road Glide 3, and Low Rider S
item.description: Harley-Davidson expands its 2026 lineup with new chrome trim options for the Road Glide 3 and Low Rider S, plus a solo-seat Road Glide .

item.title: 12 New Motorcycle Products Every Harley Rider Should Consider
item.description: Check out these 12 new motorcycle products for Harley-Davidson and V-Twin riders including upgrades from Saddlemen, Kraus, Feuling, Simpson, Trask Performance, and more.

item.title: Trask Performance Big Papi High Flow Air Cleaner First Look
item.description: Trask Performance introduces the Big Papi High Flow Air Cleaner for Harley-Davidson M8 Touring and Softail models, delivering improved airflow, throttle response, and premium billet construction.

item.title: Ken’s Factory Next-Level Knucklehead: A Modern Custom Knuckle Built from the Ground Up
item.description: Ken’s Factory builds a stunning modern Knucklehead powered by a 93ci S&amp;S engine, featuring a custom frame, perimeter brake system, and handcrafted details throughout.

item.title: Custom 1983 Harley-Davidson FXR by The Cutrate Debuts at Sturgis Motorcycle Rally
item.description: Builder Oliver Jones of The Cutrate resurrects a custom chrome-laden 1983 Harley-Davidson FXR six years after its Born-Free debut, unveiling a refined version at the Sturgis Motorcycle Rally with one-off machining and a radical Evo-based engine.

item.title: Installing 2025 Harley-Davidson Low Rider ST Saddlebags on a 2021 Low Rider S
item.description: Learn how to install the new 2025 Harley-Davidson Low Rider ST saddlebags on an earlier Low Rider S or ST. This step-by-step guide shows how equal-size bags fix the offset saddlebag problem on M8 Softails

item.title: Unreal Moto: Inside Phoenix’s Hidden FXR Goldmine
item.description: Unreal Moto in Phoenix, AZ is quietly building one of the strongest FXR collections in the country, specializing in Evolution-era Harley-Davidsons, carbureted bikes, and rare finds.

item.title: Italian Precision Meets American Muscle: Bad Boys Garage’s Custom Performance Bagger
item.description: Bad Boys Garage in Italy unveils a handcrafted performance bagger at Motor Bike Expo 2025, blending CNC precision, modern performance, and custom V-twin style.

item.title: How Led Sled’s Custom Sportster Chopper Reignited A Mom’s Passion
item.description: After years away from motorcycles, Kim Petit returns to riding with a custom Led Sled Sportster chopper built just for her—proving the passion never fades.

item.title: S&S Cycle 131ci Kit for M8 Models: Sleeper Big-Inch Power Without the Hassle
item.description: S&S Cycle introduces its 131ci big bore kit for 2017-up Milwaukee-Eight engines. Bolt-in performance, no machining required, and stealth OEM looks.

item.title: Hot Bike Magazine Vol. 1 2026 Preview: Saddlemen’s FXR-R, the Best From Motor Bike Expo and Mooneyes Japan, Plus Much More!
item.description: Get a first look at Hot Bike Magazine Vol. 1 2026 featuring the Saddlemen FXR-R, global custom builds, Motor Bike Expo highlights, and more from the V-twin world.

item.title: Bagger World Cup Debuts at MotoGP COTA 2026
item.description: The inaugural FIM Harley-Davidson Bagger World Cup launches at MotoGP COTA 2026 with a global rider lineup, Saddlemen Racing expansion, and Eric Granado topping the first-ever test.

item.title: Saddlemen FXR-R: The Air-Cooled Super Hooligan Race Bike
item.description: Inside Saddlemen Race Development’s FXR-R—a 131ci air-cooled Harley-Davidson FXR built to battle modern machines in MotoAmerica’s Super Hooligan series.

item.title: S&S P-Series Panhead Build by Satomari Motorcycle Proves Less Is More at Mooneyes Japan
item.description: Yusaku Sato’s S&S P-Series Panhead-inspired build from Satomari Motorcycle highlights minimalist design and precision craftsmanship at Mooneyes Japan.
